Kelley, Press-Telegram/SCNG) By City News Service | news@socalnews.comPUBLISHED: April 18, 2026 at 12:00 PM PDT Thousands of festivalgoers were expected in Indio Saturday for the second day of weekend two of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, with Justin Bieber set to headline. Bieber is scheduled to perform at 11:25 p.m. Saturday on the Coachella Stage. Other performers will include Giveon, The Strokes, Nine Inch Nails, Morat and Geese.
